		     Skipped when skipShopSession is set (isolated component previews — not shop pages). --><!-- vt:(a) sessions.js — uses sessionStorage guards (hasSession + expiry); safe across navigations --><script>// Function to create a session

// Which IONOS TLD each market's shop API lives on.
const SHOP_API_TLDS = {de: 'de', at: 'at', uk: 'co.uk', us: 'com', ca: 'ca', fr: 'fr', es: 'es', it: 'it', mx: 'mx'};

// Where the market is written in a hostname: on the IONOS domains it is the TLD
// (www.ionos.de -> de). The marked region is for the evaluation domains and is cut out of
// EDGE_RUNTIME=static releases (helpers/sessionsScript.ts), which only run on IONOS domains.
function marketFromHostname(hostname) {
	return hostname.split('.').pop();
}

function createSession() {
	const hostname = window.location.hostname;
	let market = marketFromHostname(hostname);
	let tld;

	if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname.endsWith('.localhost')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = 'de';
	} else if (hostname.endsWith('.lan')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = hostname.split('.').reverse().pop();
	} else {
		// `com` only reaches here from www.ionos.com; the evaluation hosts already yield `us`.
		if (market === 'com') {
			market = 'us';
		}
		tld = SHOP_API_TLDS[market];
		if (!tld) {
			// An unrecognised host (a raw *.pages.dev preview, say). Guessing a TLD would call
			// a hostname that does not resolve, so fall back to the same target local dev uses.
			console.warn(`[sessions] no market for hostname ${hostname}; falling back to de`);
			market = 'de';
			tld = 'de';
		}
		// Austria talks to shop-api.ionos.at but identifies as market `de`, as it always has.
		if (market === 'at') {
			market = 'de';
		}
	}

	fetch(`https://shop-api.ionos.${tld}/v1/api/shop/session`, {
		method: 'GET',
		credentials: 'include',
		headers: {
			'Content-Type': 'application/json',
			'x-market': market,
		},
	})
		.then((response) => {
			response.json();
		})
		.then(() => {
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('hasSession', 'true');
			// Save the timestamp
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('sessionTimestamp', Date.now());
		})
		.catch((error) => {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('sessionTimestamp');
			console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
		});
}

function isSessionExpired() {
	const sessionTimestamp = window.sessionStorage.getItem('sessionTimestamp');
	if (sessionTimestamp) {
		const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - 3600000; // 1 hour in milliseconds
		if (parseInt(sessionTimestamp) < oneHourAgo) {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			return true; // Session has expired
		} else {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

if (!window.sessionStorage.getItem('hasSession') || isSessionExpired()) {
	console.log('no session');
	createSession();
}

setInterval(() => {
	if (!document?.hidden && isSessionExpired()) {
		createSession();
	}
}, 10000);

/* ── Bar target heights per breakpoint (CSS custom property on each bar) ── */
/* Values match Framer Motion animate targets exactly.                        */
/* height:var(--cs-h) here (not just inside the keyframe below) is the bar's  */
/* SETTLED, non-animated state — required because qa/executors/visual-diff's  */
/* capture.mjs freezes every page with 'animation:none!important' before      */
/* screenshotting, for both candidate and reference, to kill flaky reveals.   */
/* The legacy React twin's Framer Motion bars are driven by inline styles, so */
/* that freeze doesn't touch them — they simply finish playing and hold their */
/* final height. Our bars are pure CSS @keyframes, so 'animation:none' cancels */
/* them outright; with no other height rule they collapsed to 0, clipping the */
/* absolutely-positioned images anchored inside cs-bar3 (parity issue #1621 — */
/* "missing right-hand visual"). Declaring the target height as the element's */
/* own (non-animation) value fixes the frozen/reduced-motion case for free:   */
/* the animation still overrides it while actually playing (animations beat   */
/* normal declarations in the cascade) and ends at this same value anyway.    */
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:150px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:220px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:340px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:320px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{--cs-h:90%;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg.cs-bar-bg-alt{--cs-h:95%}
/* Breakpoints below are tailwind.screens.config.js md/lg (580/1025), the same ones the  */
/* tw- classes and the legacy useBreakpoint() use — NOT 768/1024. With 768 the 580-767px */
/* range got md layout classes but mobile bar heights, pushing the visual ~60px down.    */
@media(min-width:580px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:180px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:270px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:400px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:370px}
}
@media(min-width:1025px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:320px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:450px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:650px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:600px}
}
/* ── Bar grow: HEIGHT animation (not scaleY) ──────────────────────────── */
/* CRITICAL: scaleY on cs-bar3 squashes its absolutely-positioned child    */
/* images. height animation does not apply a transform to children.        */
/* Delays/duration/easing match production Framer Motion exactly:          */
/* bar1=0s, bar2=0.4s, bar3=0.5s, bar4=0s, bar-bg=0s; 1.2s ease-in-out   */
@keyframes cs-bar-grow{from{height:0}to{height:var(--cs-h)}}
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.4s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.5s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
/* ── Image slide-in: separate move + fade, matching production variants ── */
/* Production uses two Framer Motion variants simultaneously:               */
/*   moved  (translate): delay 0.7s, duration 1.5s                         */
/*   visible (opacity) : delay 1.7s, duration 0.8s                         */
/* Images slide invisibly for ~1s, then fade in near their final position.  */
/* transform/opacity below are the same settled-state fallback as the bar   */
/* heights above — the frozen/reduced-motion end state, overridden while the */
/* animation actually plays and matching where it ends up regardless.       */
.cs-anim .cs-img{
  --cs-tx:-180px;
  --cs-start:200px;
  transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg);
  opacity:1;
  animation:
    cs-slide-img-move 1.5s ease-in-out 0.7s both,
    cs-slide-img-fade 0.8s ease-in-out 1.7s both
}
@media(min-width:580px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-start:300px}}
@media(min-width:1025px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-230px}}
@media(min-width:1280px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-350px}}
/* rotate(25deg) in keyframe intentionally: CSS animation owns the full     */
/* transform property, nullifying tw-rotate-[25deg] during the animation.  */
@keyframes cs-slide-img-move{
  from{transform:translateX(var(--cs-start)) translateY(var(--cs-start)) rotate(25deg)}
  to{transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg)}
}
@keyframes cs-slide-img-fade{
  from{opacity:0}
  to{opacity:1}
}

		     Skipped when skipShopSession is set (isolated component previews — not shop pages). --><!-- vt:(a) sessions.js — uses sessionStorage guards (hasSession + expiry); safe across navigations --><script>// Function to create a session

// Which IONOS TLD each market's shop API lives on.
const SHOP_API_TLDS = {de: 'de', at: 'at', uk: 'co.uk', us: 'com', ca: 'ca', fr: 'fr', es: 'es', it: 'it', mx: 'mx'};

// Where the market is written in a hostname: on the IONOS domains it is the TLD
// (www.ionos.de -> de). The marked region is for the evaluation domains and is cut out of
// EDGE_RUNTIME=static releases (helpers/sessionsScript.ts), which only run on IONOS domains.
function marketFromHostname(hostname) {
	return hostname.split('.').pop();
}

function createSession() {
	const hostname = window.location.hostname;
	let market = marketFromHostname(hostname);
	let tld;

	if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname.endsWith('.localhost')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = 'de';
	} else if (hostname.endsWith('.lan')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = hostname.split('.').reverse().pop();
	} else {
		// `com` only reaches here from www.ionos.com; the evaluation hosts already yield `us`.
		if (market === 'com') {
			market = 'us';
		}
		tld = SHOP_API_TLDS[market];
		if (!tld) {
			// An unrecognised host (a raw *.pages.dev preview, say). Guessing a TLD would call
			// a hostname that does not resolve, so fall back to the same target local dev uses.
			console.warn(`[sessions] no market for hostname ${hostname}; falling back to de`);
			market = 'de';
			tld = 'de';
		}
		// Austria talks to shop-api.ionos.at but identifies as market `de`, as it always has.
		if (market === 'at') {
			market = 'de';
		}
	}

	fetch(`https://shop-api.ionos.${tld}/v1/api/shop/session`, {
		method: 'GET',
		credentials: 'include',
		headers: {
			'Content-Type': 'application/json',
			'x-market': market,
		},
	})
		.then((response) => {
			response.json();
		})
		.then(() => {
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('hasSession', 'true');
			// Save the timestamp
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('sessionTimestamp', Date.now());
		})
		.catch((error) => {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('sessionTimestamp');
			console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
		});
}

function isSessionExpired() {
	const sessionTimestamp = window.sessionStorage.getItem('sessionTimestamp');
	if (sessionTimestamp) {
		const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - 3600000; // 1 hour in milliseconds
		if (parseInt(sessionTimestamp) < oneHourAgo) {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			return true; // Session has expired
		} else {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

if (!window.sessionStorage.getItem('hasSession') || isSessionExpired()) {
	console.log('no session');
	createSession();
}

setInterval(() => {
	if (!document?.hidden && isSessionExpired()) {
		createSession();
	}
}, 10000);

/* ── Bar target heights per breakpoint (CSS custom property on each bar) ── */
/* Values match Framer Motion animate targets exactly.                        */
/* height:var(--cs-h) here (not just inside the keyframe below) is the bar's  */
/* SETTLED, non-animated state — required because qa/executors/visual-diff's  */
/* capture.mjs freezes every page with 'animation:none!important' before      */
/* screenshotting, for both candidate and reference, to kill flaky reveals.   */
/* The legacy React twin's Framer Motion bars are driven by inline styles, so */
/* that freeze doesn't touch them — they simply finish playing and hold their */
/* final height. Our bars are pure CSS @keyframes, so 'animation:none' cancels */
/* them outright; with no other height rule they collapsed to 0, clipping the */
/* absolutely-positioned images anchored inside cs-bar3 (parity issue #1621 — */
/* "missing right-hand visual"). Declaring the target height as the element's */
/* own (non-animation) value fixes the frozen/reduced-motion case for free:   */
/* the animation still overrides it while actually playing (animations beat   */
/* normal declarations in the cascade) and ends at this same value anyway.    */
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:150px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:220px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:340px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:320px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{--cs-h:90%;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg.cs-bar-bg-alt{--cs-h:95%}
/* Breakpoints below are tailwind.screens.config.js md/lg (580/1025), the same ones the  */
/* tw- classes and the legacy useBreakpoint() use — NOT 768/1024. With 768 the 580-767px */
/* range got md layout classes but mobile bar heights, pushing the visual ~60px down.    */
@media(min-width:580px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:180px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:270px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:400px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:370px}
}
@media(min-width:1025px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:320px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:450px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:650px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:600px}
}
/* ── Bar grow: HEIGHT animation (not scaleY) ──────────────────────────── */
/* CRITICAL: scaleY on cs-bar3 squashes its absolutely-positioned child    */
/* images. height animation does not apply a transform to children.        */
/* Delays/duration/easing match production Framer Motion exactly:          */
/* bar1=0s, bar2=0.4s, bar3=0.5s, bar4=0s, bar-bg=0s; 1.2s ease-in-out   */
@keyframes cs-bar-grow{from{height:0}to{height:var(--cs-h)}}
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.4s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.5s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
/* ── Image slide-in: separate move + fade, matching production variants ── */
/* Production uses two Framer Motion variants simultaneously:               */
/*   moved  (translate): delay 0.7s, duration 1.5s                         */
/*   visible (opacity) : delay 1.7s, duration 0.8s                         */
/* Images slide invisibly for ~1s, then fade in near their final position.  */
/* transform/opacity below are the same settled-state fallback as the bar   */
/* heights above — the frozen/reduced-motion end state, overridden while the */
/* animation actually plays and matching where it ends up regardless.       */
.cs-anim .cs-img{
  --cs-tx:-180px;
  --cs-start:200px;
  transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg);
  opacity:1;
  animation:
    cs-slide-img-move 1.5s ease-in-out 0.7s both,
    cs-slide-img-fade 0.8s ease-in-out 1.7s both
}
@media(min-width:580px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-start:300px}}
@media(min-width:1025px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-230px}}
@media(min-width:1280px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-350px}}
/* rotate(25deg) in keyframe intentionally: CSS animation owns the full     */
/* transform property, nullifying tw-rotate-[25deg] during the animation.  */
@keyframes cs-slide-img-move{
  from{transform:translateX(var(--cs-start)) translateY(var(--cs-start)) rotate(25deg)}
  to{transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg)}
}
@keyframes cs-slide-img-fade{
  from{opacity:0}
  to{opacity:1}
}

		     Skipped when skipShopSession is set (isolated component previews — not shop pages). --><!-- vt:(a) sessions.js — uses sessionStorage guards (hasSession + expiry); safe across navigations --><script>// Function to create a session

// Which IONOS TLD each market's shop API lives on.
const SHOP_API_TLDS = {de: 'de', at: 'at', uk: 'co.uk', us: 'com', ca: 'ca', fr: 'fr', es: 'es', it: 'it', mx: 'mx'};

// Where the market is written in a hostname: on the IONOS domains it is the TLD
// (www.ionos.de -> de). The marked region is for the evaluation domains and is cut out of
// EDGE_RUNTIME=static releases (helpers/sessionsScript.ts), which only run on IONOS domains.
function marketFromHostname(hostname) {
	return hostname.split('.').pop();
}

function createSession() {
	const hostname = window.location.hostname;
	let market = marketFromHostname(hostname);
	let tld;

	if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname.endsWith('.localhost')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = 'de';
	} else if (hostname.endsWith('.lan')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = hostname.split('.').reverse().pop();
	} else {
		// `com` only reaches here from www.ionos.com; the evaluation hosts already yield `us`.
		if (market === 'com') {
			market = 'us';
		}
		tld = SHOP_API_TLDS[market];
		if (!tld) {
			// An unrecognised host (a raw *.pages.dev preview, say). Guessing a TLD would call
			// a hostname that does not resolve, so fall back to the same target local dev uses.
			console.warn(`[sessions] no market for hostname ${hostname}; falling back to de`);
			market = 'de';
			tld = 'de';
		}
		// Austria talks to shop-api.ionos.at but identifies as market `de`, as it always has.
		if (market === 'at') {
			market = 'de';
		}
	}

	fetch(`https://shop-api.ionos.${tld}/v1/api/shop/session`, {
		method: 'GET',
		credentials: 'include',
		headers: {
			'Content-Type': 'application/json',
			'x-market': market,
		},
	})
		.then((response) => {
			response.json();
		})
		.then(() => {
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('hasSession', 'true');
			// Save the timestamp
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('sessionTimestamp', Date.now());
		})
		.catch((error) => {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('sessionTimestamp');
			console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
		});
}

function isSessionExpired() {
	const sessionTimestamp = window.sessionStorage.getItem('sessionTimestamp');
	if (sessionTimestamp) {
		const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - 3600000; // 1 hour in milliseconds
		if (parseInt(sessionTimestamp) < oneHourAgo) {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			return true; // Session has expired
		} else {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

if (!window.sessionStorage.getItem('hasSession') || isSessionExpired()) {
	console.log('no session');
	createSession();
}

setInterval(() => {
	if (!document?.hidden && isSessionExpired()) {
		createSession();
	}
}, 10000);

 * Inline submit handler for StandaloneCheckerStatic.
 *
 * Replaces two React hooks:
 *  - MultiChecker's onSubmit (URL construction per checkerType)
 *  - useAdditionalParameters (UTM params from sessionStorage.current_url)
 *
 * The script reads all runtime values from data-* attributes baked onto
 * the <form> at SSR time — no runtime env access needed.
 *
 * data-* attributes on <form>:
 *   data-checker-type   — 'domain' | 'domaintransfer' | 'rankingCoach'
 *   data-shop-url       — DOMAINSHOP_URL from build-time env
 *   data-tld            — articleLabel or COUNTRY-derived TLD (may be empty)
 *   data-input-name     — name of the text input field
 *
 * wireDomainCheckerForm(form) wires ONE domain-checker form, guarded by a data flag
 * (matching ai-checker-script.js / bulk-domain-checker-script.js) so calling it twice for
 * the same form never double-attaches the submit listener.
 *
 * Two different consumers need two different syntaxes from this one file (see
 * ai-checker-script.js's header for the full explanation, which this mirrors):
 *  - standalone-checker-static.tsx reads it via Vite's ?raw and inlines it as a plain
 *    (non-module) <script> after the <form> — document.currentScript.previousElementSibling
 *    locates the form there, so the <script> tag MUST immediately follow the <form> in the
 *    HTML — stripping the leading `export ` first since classic scripts can't contain
 *    `export`/`import`.
 *  - checker-sub-component-static.tsx (portal-mounted consumers, whose inline <script>
 *    never executes) imports wireDomainCheckerForm as a real ES export and calls it from
 *    a useEffect instead.
 */
function wireDomainCheckerForm(form) {
  if (!form || form.tagName !== 'FORM' || form.dataset.domainCheckerFormWired) return;
  form.dataset.domainCheckerFormWired = 'true';

  // Legacy checker-sub-component.tsx's `domain-search-input-field-in-focus-${focus}` — the id
  // qa-customer-platforms-ui finds this form by. On the field, not the form: the form keeps
  // exactly one listener (submit).
  var field = form.querySelector('input');
  var markFocus = function (on) { form.setAttribute('data-testid', 'domain-search-input-field-in-focus-' + on); };
  markFocus(false);
  if (field) {
    field.addEventListener('focus', function () { markFocus(true); });
    field.addEventListener('blur', function () { markFocus(false); });
  }

  // Empty submit: show the localized inline message instead of the browser's bubble
  // (legacy checker-input-field.tsx onInvalid); any interaction with the field hides it.
  var input = form.querySelector('input[required]');
  var error = form.querySelector('[data-checker-error]');
  if (input && error) {
    var hideError = function () { error.classList.add('tw-hidden'); };
    input.addEventListener('invalid', function (e) {
      if (!input.validity.valueMissing) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      error.classList.remove('tw-hidden');
    });
    input.addEventListener('focus', hideError);
    input.addEventListener('input', hideError);
    error.addEventListener('click', hideError);
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    var fd = new FormData(form);
    var domain = String(fd.get(form.dataset.inputName) || '').replace(/ /g, '');
    if (!domain) return;

    var type = form.dataset.checkerType;
    var shopUrl = form.dataset.shopUrl;
    var tld = form.dataset.tld || '';

    // Replicate useAdditionalParameters: append UTM params stored by the
    // previous page visit (written to sessionStorage.current_url by tracking).
    var extra = '';
    try {
      var currentUrl = sessionStorage.getItem('current_url');
      if (currentUrl) {
        var cleanUrl = currentUrl.includes('#') ? currentUrl.split('#')[0] : currentUrl;
        var params = new URLSearchParams(new URL(cleanUrl).search);
        params.delete('contract'); // contract param must never be forwarded
        if (params.toString()) extra = '&' + params.toString();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // sessionStorage unavailable (private mode, cross-origin) — proceed without params
    }

    // Domain transfer — dedicated transfer flow
    if (type === 'domaintransfer') {
      window.location.href =
        shopUrl + 'transfer?startSearch=true&skipContractSelection=true&domains=' + domain;
      return;
    }

    // RankingCoach — internal marketing tool URL
    if (type === 'rankingCoach') {
      var port = window.location.port ? ':' + window.location.port : '';
      var base = window.location.protocol + '//' + window.location.hostname + port;
      window.location.href =
        base +
        '/marketing/rankingcoach-result?__sendingdata=1&forcestop=true' +
        '&__CMD[rankingcoach-result]:SELWRP=rankingCoachCheck' +
        '&rankingCoachCheck.rankingCoachCheckedUrl=' +
        domain;
      return;
    }

    // Default: domain search
    var skip = '&skipContractSelection=true';
    // Only append TLD suffix when the user hasn't already typed a dot-separated TLD
    var hasTld = domain.lastIndexOf('.') > -1 && domain.lastIndexOf('.') < domain.length - 1;
    var suffix = '';
    if (!hasTld && tld) {
      // tld may be: '.de' (dot-prefixed), 'de,at' (comma list → ?tlds=), or plain 'de'
      suffix = tld.startsWith('.')
        ? tld
        : tld.includes(',')
        ? '&tlds=' + tld
        : '.' + tld;
    }

    // Multi-domain (comma-separated input) vs single domain
    if (domain.includes(',')) {
      var domains = domain
        .split(',')
        .map(function (d) { return d.trim() + suffix; })
        .join(',');
      window.location.href =
        shopUrl + 'search?startSearch=true&domains=' + domains + skip + extra;
    } else {
      window.location.href =
        shopUrl + 'search?startSearch=true&domains=' + domain + suffix + skip + extra;
    }
  });
}

// {wireDomainCheckerForm}`) is also safe server-side (SSR/prerender, where `document`
// doesn't exist) — this auto-run path is only meant for the browser-executed inline
// <script>.

    var form = document.currentScript && document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
    wireDomainCheckerForm(form);

}

 *

 *   data-shop-url       — DOMAINSHOP_URL from build-time env
 *   data-tld            — articleLabel or COUNTRY-derived TLD (may be empty)
 *   data-input-name     — name of the text input field
 *

 * (matching ai-checker-script.js / bulk-domain-checker-script.js) so calling it twice for
 * the same form never double-attaches the submit listener.

 * ai-checker-script.js's header for the full explanation, which this mirrors):
 *  - standalone-checker-static.tsx reads it via Vite's ?raw and inlines it as a plain
 *    (non-module) <script> after the <form> — document.currentScript.previousElementSibling

 *    HTML — stripping the leading `export ` first since classic scripts can't contain
 *    `export`/`import`.

 *    never executes) imports wireDomainCheckerForm as a real ES export and calls it from
 *    a useEffect instead.

  if (!form || form.tagName !== 'FORM' || form.dataset.domainCheckerFormWired) return;
  form.dataset.domainCheckerFormWired = 'true';

  // Legacy checker-sub-component.tsx's `domain-search-input-field-in-focus-${focus}` — the id
  // qa-customer-platforms-ui finds this form by. On the field, not the form: the form keeps
  // exactly one listener (submit).

  // (legacy checker-input-field.tsx onInvalid); any interaction with the field hides it.

        .split(',')
        .map(function (d) { return d.trim() + suffix; })
        .join(',');

        shopUrl + 'search?startSearch=true&domains=' + domains + skip + extra;
    } else {

        shopUrl + 'search?startSearch=true&domains=' + domain + suffix + skip + extra;
    }

// Which IONOS TLD each market's shop API lives on.
const SHOP_API_TLDS = {de: 'de', at: 'at', uk: 'co.uk', us: 'com', ca: 'ca', fr: 'fr', es: 'es', it: 'it', mx: 'mx'};

// Where the market is written in a hostname: on the IONOS domains it is the TLD
// (www.ionos.de -> de). The marked region is for the evaluation domains and is cut out of
// EDGE_RUNTIME=static releases (helpers/sessionsScript.ts), which only run on IONOS domains.
function marketFromHostname(hostname) {
	return hostname.split('.').pop();
}

function createSession() {
	const hostname = window.location.hostname;
	let market = marketFromHostname(hostname);
	let tld;

	if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname.endsWith('.localhost')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = 'de';
	} else if (hostname.endsWith('.lan')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = hostname.split('.').reverse().pop();
	} else {
		// `com` only reaches here from www.ionos.com; the evaluation hosts already yield `us`.
		if (market === 'com') {
			market = 'us';
		}
		tld = SHOP_API_TLDS[market];
		if (!tld) {
			// An unrecognised host (a raw *.pages.dev preview, say). Guessing a TLD would call
			// a hostname that does not resolve, so fall back to the same target local dev uses.
			console.warn(`[sessions] no market for hostname ${hostname}; falling back to de`);
			market = 'de';
			tld = 'de';
		}
		// Austria talks to shop-api.ionos.at but identifies as market `de`, as it always has.
		if (market === 'at') {
			market = 'de';
		}
	}

	fetch(`https://shop-api.ionos.${tld}/v1/api/shop/session`, {
		method: 'GET',

function isSessionExpired() {
	const sessionTimestamp = window.sessionStorage.getItem('sessionTimestamp');
	if (sessionTimestamp) {
		const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - 3600000; // 1 hour in milliseconds

			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			return true; // Session has expired
		} else {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

if (!window.sessionStorage.getItem('hasSession') || isSessionExpired()) {
	console.log('no session');
	createSession();
}

	if (!document?.hidden && isSessionExpired()) {
		createSession();
	}

/* ── Bar target heights per breakpoint (CSS custom property on each bar) ── */
/* Values match Framer Motion animate targets exactly.                        */
/* height:var(--cs-h) here (not just inside the keyframe below) is the bar's  */
/* SETTLED, non-animated state — required because qa/executors/visual-diff's  */
/* capture.mjs freezes every page with 'animation:none!important' before      */
/* screenshotting, for both candidate and reference, to kill flaky reveals.   */
/* The legacy React twin's Framer Motion bars are driven by inline styles, so */
/* that freeze doesn't touch them — they simply finish playing and hold their */
/* final height. Our bars are pure CSS @keyframes, so 'animation:none' cancels */
/* them outright; with no other height rule they collapsed to 0, clipping the */
/* absolutely-positioned images anchored inside cs-bar3 (parity issue #1621 — */
/* "missing right-hand visual"). Declaring the target height as the element's */
/* own (non-animation) value fixes the frozen/reduced-motion case for free:   */
/* the animation still overrides it while actually playing (animations beat   */
/* normal declarations in the cascade) and ends at this same value anyway.    */
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:150px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:220px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:340px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:320px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{--cs-h:90%;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg.cs-bar-bg-alt{--cs-h:95%}
/* Breakpoints below are tailwind.screens.config.js md/lg (580/1025), the same ones the  */
/* tw- classes and the legacy useBreakpoint() use — NOT 768/1024. With 768 the 580-767px */
/* range got md layout classes but mobile bar heights, pushing the visual ~60px down.    */
@media(min-width:580px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:180px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:270px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:400px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:370px}
}
@media(min-width:1025px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:320px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:450px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:650px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:600px}
}
/* ── Bar grow: HEIGHT animation (not scaleY) ──────────────────────────── */
/* CRITICAL: scaleY on cs-bar3 squashes its absolutely-positioned child    */
/* images. height animation does not apply a transform to children.        */
/* Delays/duration/easing match production Framer Motion exactly:          */
/* bar1=0s, bar2=0.4s, bar3=0.5s, bar4=0s, bar-bg=0s; 1.2s ease-in-out   */
@keyframes cs-bar-grow{from{height:0}to{height:var(--cs-h)}}
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.4s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.5s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
/* ── Image slide-in: separate move + fade, matching production variants ── */
/* Production uses two Framer Motion variants simultaneously:               */
/*   moved  (translate): delay 0.7s, duration 1.5s                         */
/*   visible (opacity) : delay 1.7s, duration 0.8s                         */
/* Images slide invisibly for ~1s, then fade in near their final position.  */
/* transform/opacity below are the same settled-state fallback as the bar   */
/* heights above — the frozen/reduced-motion end state, overridden while the */
/* animation actually plays and matching where it ends up regardless.       */
.cs-anim .cs-img{
  --cs-tx:-180px;
  --cs-start:200px;
  transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg);
  opacity:1;
  animation:
    cs-slide-img-move 1.5s ease-in-out 0.7s both,
    cs-slide-img-fade 0.8s ease-in-out 1.7s both
}
@media(min-width:580px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-start:300px}}
@media(min-width:1025px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-230px}}
@media(min-width:1280px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-350px}}
/* rotate(25deg) in keyframe intentionally: CSS animation owns the full     */
/* transform property, nullifying tw-rotate-[25deg] during the animation.  */
@keyframes cs-slide-img-move{
  from{transform:translateX(var(--cs-start)) translateY(var(--cs-start)) rotate(25deg)}
  to{transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg)}
}
@keyframes cs-slide-img-fade{
  from{opacity:0}
  to{opacity:1}
}

		     Skipped when skipShopSession is set (isolated component previews — not shop pages). --><!-- vt:(a) sessions.js — uses sessionStorage guards (hasSession + expiry); safe across navigations --><script>// Function to create a session

// Which IONOS TLD each market's shop API lives on.
const SHOP_API_TLDS = {de: 'de', at: 'at', uk: 'co.uk', us: 'com', ca: 'ca', fr: 'fr', es: 'es', it: 'it', mx: 'mx'};

// Where the market is written in a hostname: on the IONOS domains it is the TLD
// (www.ionos.de -> de). The marked region is for the evaluation domains and is cut out of
// EDGE_RUNTIME=static releases (helpers/sessionsScript.ts), which only run on IONOS domains.
function marketFromHostname(hostname) {
	return hostname.split('.').pop();
}

function createSession() {
	const hostname = window.location.hostname;
	let market = marketFromHostname(hostname);
	let tld;

	if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname.endsWith('.localhost')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = 'de';
	} else if (hostname.endsWith('.lan')) {
		market = 'localhost';
		tld = hostname.split('.').reverse().pop();
	} else {
		// `com` only reaches here from www.ionos.com; the evaluation hosts already yield `us`.
		if (market === 'com') {
			market = 'us';
		}
		tld = SHOP_API_TLDS[market];
		if (!tld) {
			// An unrecognised host (a raw *.pages.dev preview, say). Guessing a TLD would call
			// a hostname that does not resolve, so fall back to the same target local dev uses.
			console.warn(`[sessions] no market for hostname ${hostname}; falling back to de`);
			market = 'de';
			tld = 'de';
		}
		// Austria talks to shop-api.ionos.at but identifies as market `de`, as it always has.
		if (market === 'at') {
			market = 'de';
		}
	}

	fetch(`https://shop-api.ionos.${tld}/v1/api/shop/session`, {
		method: 'GET',
		credentials: 'include',
		headers: {
			'Content-Type': 'application/json',
			'x-market': market,
		},
	})
		.then((response) => {
			response.json();
		})
		.then(() => {
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('hasSession', 'true');
			// Save the timestamp
			window.sessionStorage.setItem('sessionTimestamp', Date.now());
		})
		.catch((error) => {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('sessionTimestamp');
			console.error('There was a problem with the fetch operation:', error);
		});
}

function isSessionExpired() {
	const sessionTimestamp = window.sessionStorage.getItem('sessionTimestamp');
	if (sessionTimestamp) {
		const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - 3600000; // 1 hour in milliseconds
		if (parseInt(sessionTimestamp) < oneHourAgo) {
			window.sessionStorage.removeItem('hasSession');
			return true; // Session has expired
		} else {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

if (!window.sessionStorage.getItem('hasSession') || isSessionExpired()) {
	console.log('no session');
	createSession();
}

setInterval(() => {
	if (!document?.hidden && isSessionExpired()) {
		createSession();
	}
}, 10000);

/* ── Bar target heights per breakpoint (CSS custom property on each bar) ── */
/* Values match Framer Motion animate targets exactly.                        */
/* height:var(--cs-h) here (not just inside the keyframe below) is the bar's  */
/* SETTLED, non-animated state — required because qa/executors/visual-diff's  */
/* capture.mjs freezes every page with 'animation:none!important' before      */
/* screenshotting, for both candidate and reference, to kill flaky reveals.   */
/* The legacy React twin's Framer Motion bars are driven by inline styles, so */
/* that freeze doesn't touch them — they simply finish playing and hold their */
/* final height. Our bars are pure CSS @keyframes, so 'animation:none' cancels */
/* them outright; with no other height rule they collapsed to 0, clipping the */
/* absolutely-positioned images anchored inside cs-bar3 (parity issue #1621 — */
/* "missing right-hand visual"). Declaring the target height as the element's */
/* own (non-animation) value fixes the frozen/reduced-motion case for free:   */
/* the animation still overrides it while actually playing (animations beat   */
/* normal declarations in the cascade) and ends at this same value anyway.    */
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:150px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:220px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:340px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:320px;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{--cs-h:90%;height:var(--cs-h)}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg.cs-bar-bg-alt{--cs-h:95%}
/* Breakpoints below are tailwind.screens.config.js md/lg (580/1025), the same ones the  */
/* tw- classes and the legacy useBreakpoint() use — NOT 768/1024. With 768 the 580-767px */
/* range got md layout classes but mobile bar heights, pushing the visual ~60px down.    */
@media(min-width:580px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:180px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:270px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:400px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:370px}
}
@media(min-width:1025px){
  .cs-anim .cs-bar1{--cs-h:320px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar2{--cs-h:450px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar3{--cs-h:650px}
  .cs-anim .cs-bar4{--cs-h:600px}
}
/* ── Bar grow: HEIGHT animation (not scaleY) ──────────────────────────── */
/* CRITICAL: scaleY on cs-bar3 squashes its absolutely-positioned child    */
/* images. height animation does not apply a transform to children.        */
/* Delays/duration/easing match production Framer Motion exactly:          */
/* bar1=0s, bar2=0.4s, bar3=0.5s, bar4=0s, bar-bg=0s; 1.2s ease-in-out   */
@keyframes cs-bar-grow{from{height:0}to{height:var(--cs-h)}}
.cs-anim .cs-bar1{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar2{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.4s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar3{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0.5s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar4{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
.cs-anim .cs-bar-bg{animation:cs-bar-grow 1.2s ease-in-out 0s both}
/* ── Image slide-in: separate move + fade, matching production variants ── */
/* Production uses two Framer Motion variants simultaneously:               */
/*   moved  (translate): delay 0.7s, duration 1.5s                         */
/*   visible (opacity) : delay 1.7s, duration 0.8s                         */
/* Images slide invisibly for ~1s, then fade in near their final position.  */
/* transform/opacity below are the same settled-state fallback as the bar   */
/* heights above — the frozen/reduced-motion end state, overridden while the */
/* animation actually plays and matching where it ends up regardless.       */
.cs-anim .cs-img{
  --cs-tx:-180px;
  --cs-start:200px;
  transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg);
  opacity:1;
  animation:
    cs-slide-img-move 1.5s ease-in-out 0.7s both,
    cs-slide-img-fade 0.8s ease-in-out 1.7s both
}
@media(min-width:580px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-start:300px}}
@media(min-width:1025px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-230px}}
@media(min-width:1280px){.cs-anim .cs-img{--cs-tx:-350px}}
/* rotate(25deg) in keyframe intentionally: CSS animation owns the full     */
/* transform property, nullifying tw-rotate-[25deg] during the animation.  */
@keyframes cs-slide-img-move{
  from{transform:translateX(var(--cs-start)) translateY(var(--cs-start)) rotate(25deg)}
  to{transform:translateX(var(--cs-tx)) translateY(0) rotate(25deg)}
}
@keyframes cs-slide-img-fade{
  from{opacity:0}
  to{opacity:1}
}
